theorem PV_DIAG6.write_step_joint : ∀ {S E : Type} (rel : S → S → Prop) (a b : PV_DIAG3.WriteOps S E)
  (ka kb : PV_DIAG3.Bytes → PV_DIAG3.Op S (Except E Unit)) (buf : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (s t : S),
  rel s t →
    a.zeroError = b.zeroError →
      (∀ (bs : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.write bs u) (b.write bs v)) →
        (∀ (e : E) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.interruptedGuard e u) (b.interruptedGuard e v)) →
          (∀ (e : E) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.dropInterrupted e u) (b.dropInterrupted e v)) →
            (∀ (bs : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (n : ℕ) (u v : S),
                rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (a.slicePanic bs n u) (b.slicePanic bs n v)) →
              (∀ (bs : PV_DIAG3.Bytes) (u v : S), rel u v → PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (ka bs u) (kb bs v)) →
                PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel (PV_DIAG3.writeAllStep a buf ka s) (PV_DIAG3.writeAllStep b buf kb t) :=
fun {S E} rel a b ka kb buf s t h hz hw hg hd hp hk =>
  id
    (Decidable.casesOn (instDecidableEqBool (List.isEmpty buf) true)
      (fun h_1 =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congr (congrArg (PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel) (congrFun (if_neg h_1) s)) (congrFun (if_neg h_1) t)))
          (PV_DIAG3.coupled_bind rel (a.write buf s) (b.write buf t)
            (fun r =>
              match r with
              | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error a.zeroError)
              | Except.ok n.succ =>
                if n + 1 ≤ List.length buf then ka (List.drop (n + 1) buf) else a.slicePanic buf (n + 1)
              | Except.error e =>
                PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.interruptedGuard e) fun interrupted =>
                  if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.dropInterrupted e) fun x => ka buf
                  else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
            (fun r =>
              match r with
              | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error b.zeroError)
              | Except.ok n.succ =>
                if n + 1 ≤ List.length buf then kb (List.drop (n + 1) buf) else b.slicePanic buf (n + 1)
              | Except.error e =>
                PV_DIAG3.sequence (b.interruptedGuard e) fun interrupted =>
                  if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (b.dropInterrupted e) fun x => kb buf
                  else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
            (hw buf s t h) fun out u v huv =>
            Except.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
              out = t →
                PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel
                  ((match out with
                    | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error a.zeroError)
                    | Except.ok n.succ =>
                      if n + 1 ≤ List.length buf then ka (List.drop (n + 1) buf) else a.slicePanic buf (n + 1)
                    | Except.error e =>
                      PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.interruptedGuard e) fun interrupted =>
                        if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.dropInterrupted e) fun x => ka buf
                        else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
                    u)
                  ((match out with
                    | Except.ok 0 => PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error b.zeroError)
                    | Except.ok n.succ =>
                      if n + 1 ≤ List.length buf then kb (List.drop (n + 1) buf) else b.slicePanic buf (n + 1)
                    | Except.error e =>
                      PV_DIAG3.sequence (b.interruptedGuard e) fun interrupted =>
                        if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (b.dropInterrupted e) fun x => kb buf
                        else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
                    v))
              out
              (fun e h =>
                Eq.symm h ▸
                  PV_DIAG3.coupled_bind rel (a.interruptedGuard e u) (b.interruptedGuard e v)
                    (fun interrupted =>
                      if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.dropInterrupted e) fun x => ka buf
                      else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
                    (fun interrupted =>
                      if interrupted = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (b.dropInterrupted e) fun x => kb buf
                      else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
                    (hg e u v huv) fun flag x y hxy =>
                    Bool.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                      flag = t →
                        PV_DIAG3.Coupled rel
                          ((if flag = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (a.dropInterrupted e) fun x => ka buf
                            else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
                            x)
                          ((if flag = true then PV_DIAG3.sequence (b.dropInterrupted e) fun x => kb buf
                            else PV_DIAG3.pure (Except.error e))
                            y))
                      flag (fun h => Eq.symm h ▸ PV_DIAG3.coupled_pure rel (Except.error e) x y hxy)
                      (fun h =>
                        Eq.symm h ▸
                          PV_DIAG3.coupled_bind rel (a.dropInterrupted e x) (b.dropInterrupted e y) (fun a => ka buf)
                            (fun a => kb buf) (hd e x y hxy) fun x z z' hzz => hk buf z z' hzz)
                      (Eq.refl flag))
              (fun n h =>
                Eq.symm h ▸
                  Nat.casesAuxOn (motive := fun a_1 =>
                    n = a_1 →
